hypothesis: Count-source adjustment might only alter origin/destination effects; prior ridge1 marginal controls were not an exact orthogonal removal. Audit conditional count rank and isolate exact geometry-orthogonal cross-input information.
counts: Union all three Task4 incidence row sets; compare their span with exact origin/destination marginal row space. No hidden truth used.
features: Same source priors and same target folds for geometry baseline, ridge1-source pair, exactly geometry-orthogonal source pair, and shuffled-then-reprojected source pair.
projection: Pivoted QR basis of full span+origin/destination geometry with rank threshold1e-10 relative; exact source residual=(I-QQ.T)*mean normalized source prior. Within-span-bin shuffled residual reprojected into same nullspace.
target_fit: Unchanged augmented QR ridge1, unpenalized intercept, target training-fold median only. Other two public priors as source; held-out target entries not inputs.
scope: All inputs exposed. A regularized marginal predictor is distinct from exact interaction removal. Target is supplied weak prior, not hidden OD; all four models retained, no official candidate or Kaggle upload.
